dct_description_sm: Original map at: Russian State Library
Publication statement: Moscow, Russia : Glavnoe upravlenie geodezii i kartografii, 1975.

The map shows various administrative borders and settlements in 5 gradations, with the founding dates of some marked. Also noted are useful mines and communication paths. There are three inset maps covering geology, soil and climate.
